$comment: Masteriyo's four general.styling settable colours (ScriptStyle::load_custom_inline_styles(), Masteriyo 3.5.1), the --masteriyo-* vars each one drives, and the token each stays on while the stored value still equals Masteriyo's own factory default (masteriyo_get_default_settings()). Extendable's PHP reads this file plus Masteriyo's live settings at runtime and prints only the entries that still match; it never writes to Masteriyo's settings. primary_color's two --ext-masteriyo-* entries are lattice's own custom properties, not Masteriyo's — the readable link/icon ink masteriyo.fallback.css's link and icon rules reach for first, falling back to --masteriyo-color-primary (the owner's own colour) once this entry stops printing. Hand-authored, not generated — edit this, not a copy.

settings.note: No --masteriyo-* var: this one is JS-consumed only, fed to the Learn page's React app through its settings localisation (ScriptStyle.php:1905); there is nothing to print.
